note: The list behind the App's Computer tools page. The Chit Printer and the Page Reader read it to see if they're out of date, so raise a tool's version here whenever its download changes.

tools.name: Reliant Chit Printer
tools.where: The Windows computer connected to the chit printer (Star TSP700II).
tools.what: Prints Ticket System chits straight to the chit printer, with no print window.
tools.updates: Updates itself. It checks for a new version when the computer starts and every 6 hours, and only swaps it in after no chit has printed for 15 minutes.
steps: Download it and open the zip.
Double-click Install Reliant Chit Printer. If Windows warns about an unknown program, choose More info, then Run anyway.
Press Enter to keep the printer it finds, or type the number of the chit printer.
In the Ticket System, tick This computer prints chits. The note “no print window” appears within 30 seconds.

tools.name: Reliant Page Reader
tools.where: The computer that runs the live show page (TikTok, Whatnot or eBay) in Chrome.
tools.what: Reads sales off the live page and sends them to the Ticket System. Its menu opens the Reliant Tickets sidebar.
tools.updates: Chrome can't update it by itself yet. Its menu says “Update available” when there's a newer one; then follow the update steps.
steps: Download it and unzip it into a folder you'll keep (for example Documents\Reliant Page Reader).
In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode (top right).
Click Load unpacked and pick that folder.
Click the puzzle piece in Chrome's toolbar and pin Reliant Page Reader.
Open its menu and paste the connection code from the Ticket System's Sale sources.
update_steps: Download it and unzip it into the same folder, replacing the old files.
In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions and click the round arrow on Reliant Page Reader. Its connection stays.
changes: 0.4.1 (Nov 25): shows its version and “Update available” in its menu.

tools.name: Reliant Scan Helper
tools.where: The CashMonkey scanning computers (Scanning station 1 and 2) in Chrome.
tools.what: Reads each CashMonkey scan, shows the colored station banner, and adds stream and accept books to inventory.
tools.updates: Its banner rules come from the App every 20 minutes, so most changes need no download.
tools.missing: Its download isn't in the App yet. Ask Claude to add it.
changes: 0.6.3 (Nov 20): Amazon sticker barcodes; Show this computer's code.
